description: This Java class, SparkClassCommandBuilder, constructs command-line instructions to launch internal Spark classes, excluding SparkSubmit. It manages environment variables, classpath, and JVM options based on the specific Spark class being launched.

classes.name: SparkClassCommandBuilder
classes.description: A command builder for internal Spark classes that assembles JVM commands with appropriate environment and classpath settings.

methods.name: buildCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command to launch a specified Spark class with environment variables and JVM options.
